Have you ever spotted a Giant bike while cycling in the Netherlands? It’s probably the most iconic bicycle brand around! We are currently looking for a talented spray painter to join our team in Lelystad. You will be responsible for bringing our bikes to life by painting the frames in colors selected by our customers.

What we offer
- Hourly wage €17.30
- Travel allowance up till 40 km
- Nice team with enthusiastic colleagues
- Free hot meal, fresh fruit, coffee and tea
- Chance for a permanent contract
- Job with career opportunities

Who you are
As a spray painter bicycle frames at Giant, you are eager to learn the craft and take pride in delivering high-quality work. You also meet the following requirements:

- You are available full-time from Monday to Friday 07:00 AM -04:00 PM. Working on Saturday is optional;
- You speak English, as you will be working in an international environment;
- You can work accurately and you are interested in learning the new rol (experience in paint spraying cars or scooters is a plus, and being a creative and artistic person is also always an advantage);
- You are precise and quality-focused, ensuring every bicycle frame meets our high standards;
- You live in the Lelystad area, or you have your own transport;

What will you do
As a spray painter, you work with various bicycle frames. You ensure each frame is sprayed perfectly, matching the specific color requested. You have an eye for detail, a passion for working with colors, and you take pride in creating a high-quality end result.

Where will you work
Giant is globally recognized as an authority in cycling technology and innovation. Our production operations in the Netherlands are centralized at the Lelystad facility, where we combine advanced manufacturing techniques with high-quality standards. We maintain a performance-driven culture.

- Night shift: 22:00 – 06:00

- Good command of Dutch and/or English;
- Experience in production or eager to learn.
